title: Healthcare Professions: Protected Diplomas and Titles
summary: The Coordinated Law of May 10, 2015 frames healthcare professions. Verify qualifications before entrusting reserved acts or assigning a professional title.
body: Article 45 sets the qualification conditions for the registered nurse responsible for general care. It notably provides for training of at least three years and 4,600 hours of theoretical and clinical instruction. Articles 48 and 50 frame the use of the title and prohibit the employer from assigning it to an unqualified person. These provisions are read in the consolidation updated on June 18, 2026.

Article 43 frames the approval of the physiotherapist; article 59 defines the healthcare assistant and its exercise under nursing supervision. Chapter 9 transposes the European recognition of qualifications, including Directive 2005/36/CE. A foreign qualification requires the recognition procedure applicable before practice in Belgium.
Do not use the old article 25 as the current basis for visa: the consolidated text indicates it repealed since January 1, 2022. Current visa procedures are detailed by the Public Health SPF.

owner.name: SPF Justice / Chancellerie du Premier Ministre

title: Registered Nurse Responsible for General Care: Visa
summary: Require the admissible diploma and visa from the Public Health SPF. No approval is provided for the basic Belgian diploma of registered nurse responsible for general care.
body: The page updated on September 16, 2026 refers to the qualification requirements of article 45 of the Coordinated Law of May 10, 2015. In the offer, specify that performing the duties requires obtaining the Belgian professional visa.

The visa is sent automatically for graduates of establishments listed in the SPF list. In other cases, the graduate must request it through the visa portal. It is transmitted by email or eBox and available on the portal after approval.
Before starting work, verify the authorization to practice using the employer search engine linked by the SPF. For a foreign diploma, apply the specific recognition and visa procedure.

title: Specialized Nurse: Title Approval
summary: A particular professional title or a particular professional qualification requires approval. Experience in a department alone is not sufficient to use the title.
body: The SPF distinguishes particular professional titles, notably in intensive and emergency care, oncology or geriatrics, from particular professional qualifications. The criteria result from the Royal Decree of September 27, 2006 and ministerial decrees specific to each specialty.

The Communities issue approvals. If the position requires a particular professional title or particular professional qualification, request the approval decision corresponding precisely to this requirement.

On its page of September 16, 2026, the SPF indicates for the maintenance of these specializations and qualifications continuing education of 60 hours per four-year period and at least 1,500 hours of services over the last four years. Verify the supporting documents and the decree specific to the requested title.

title: Healthcare Assistant: Registration, Visa and Students
summary: To hire a healthcare assistant, verify community registration and federal visa. A student in nursing must also obtain these authorizations to hold this function.
body: After recognized training, the candidate requests registration with the competent Community. The visa follows registration and becomes available on the SPF portal after approval. The healthcare assistant assists the registered nurse responsible for general care or the nursing assistant under its supervision.

The page of September 14, 2026 provides a pathway for students who have completed the first year of nursing, nursing assistant, or midwifery. It mentions 60 ECTS for the bachelor's degree, theoretical and clinical training in gerontology and 150 hours of clinical practice, including in geriatrics.

Request the certificate attesting healthcare assistant competencies and the registration decision. Simple enrollment in nursing training does not constitute authorization to practice as a healthcare assistant.

title: Foreign Diplomas: Recognition and Language
summary: Anticipate diploma recognition and visa before starting work. The SPF also requires language evidence and professional conduct.
body: For an EEA or Swiss diploma and permanent establishment, the candidate requests recognition from the competent Community; visa processing then starts at the SPF. For a diploma outside the EEA and Switzerland, equivalence is required, then, depending on the profession, community approval or registration and a visa request.

According to the page of September 16, 2026, the required language levels are B2 for registered nurse responsible for general care, B1 for licensed nurse, A2 for healthcare assistant and C1 for physiotherapist, with B2 for written expression of the latter. The official certificate must be less than four years old; a diploma obtained in a Francophone, Dutch-speaking or German-speaking institution can also serve as proof.

The certificate of professional conduct, issued by the authorities of countries where the candidate has practiced, may not be older than three months when the application is made. The SPF issues the visa after receipt of all documents.

title: Physiotherapist: Approval and Visa
summary: The physiotherapist must have community approval and a federal visa. Verify both before entrusting care to them.
body: The competent Community issues approval of the basic diploma. The Public Health SPF then automatically issues the visa, sent by email and eBox and available on the visa portal after approval.

The page of September 14, 2026 mentions university training in physiotherapy or full-time non-university higher education training of at least four years. For foreign diplomas, the SPF refers to the specific recognition procedure.

Separate approvals exist for specialized qualifications. If the offer requires recognized specialization, verify the corresponding approval with the Community, in addition to basic authorizations. The INAMI number follows a separate procedure related to reimbursement.

title: Physiotherapy: INAMI Number and Services
summary: The INAMI number allows reimbursement of services and must correspond to the location and type of activity. Visa and approval remain separate conditions.
body: INAMI publishes article 7 of the nomenclature in its version applicable since July 1, 2026. Verify this version for the services that the physiotherapist will have to attest and the conditions for their reimbursement.

The INAMI registration guide requires the diploma, community approval, visa and a Belgian contact address. The number is assigned automatically if its application accompanied the approval and if a Belgian contact address is known; otherwise, the candidate submits the registration form.

The initial number does not allow all services to be attested. For private practice, the practitioner must register this activity in ProSanté no later than the first day to obtain the appropriate competency code, without retroactivity. Guide verified: https://www.inami.fgov.be/fr/professionnels/professionnels-de-la-sante/kinesitherapeutes/obtenir-votre-numero-inami-en-tant-que-kinesitherapeute-et-enregistrer-votre-pratique-en-cabinet . The date retained is that of the nomenclature version, the guide displaying no date.

title: IFIC: July 2026 Indexation and Scope
summary: Use the IFIC grid for July 2026 for affected private establishments. The private calculator does not constitute a validated reference for the public sector.
body: Since July 2026, IFIC applies the indexation in cents described on its page: 2% on the portion up to 4,000 euros gross monthly full-time, with a maximum increase of 80 euros for higher salaries. The formula was validated by the social partners of CP 330 on June 29, 2026.

Application to new hires or changes in position depends on the sector: federal private since May 1, 2018; Flemish regionalized private since November 1, 2019; Walloon regionalized private since January 9, 2023; Brussels regionalized private according to the establishment's date E, between October 17, 2022 and January 16, 2023.
Identify the employer's public or private status and collective bargaining field before setting the offer. Location in Flanders, Wallonia or Brussels alone does not determine the grid.

title: Private IFIC Grid as of July 1, 2026
summary: The grid provides the reference gross monthly salary by category and seniority. It does not allow assigning a category based on job title alone.
body: At zero seniority, the July 1, 2026 grid notably indicates 3,083.46 euros in category 12, 3,187.48 euros in category 14B, 3,447.52 euros in category 14 and 3,692.71 euros in category 15. These amounts are the monthly references for full-time private sector covered.

Before publishing an amount, determine the IFIC function assigned, the category and recognized seniority. Specify the work quota and distinguish the pay scale from any possible supplements. Do not present category 14 as the automatic salary for every nurse or educator.

title: Care Homes: Former CP 330 Pay Scales
summary: The official database distinguishes former pay scales from IFIC pay scales. Verify the worker's regime before using an amount in the offer or contract.
body: Sheet 3300002 concerns retirement homes, care homes, day centers, day care centers and residential services. Updated July 13, 2026, it presents the scales in effect as of July 1, 2026.

The sheet explicitly excludes workers remunerated according to an IFIC pay scale. It refers these to another sub-sector of the database. Next choose the scale and seniority corresponding to the applicable situation; do not add an old scale to an IFIC pay scale.

owner.name: SPF Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale

title: Private Hospitals: Collective Agreement for IFIC Wage Model
summary: The Collective Agreement of March 31, 2021 organizes the complete implementation of the IFIC wage model in the affected federal private services. Its scope does not indiscriminately cover all healthcare establishments.
body: Article 1 notably addresses covered hospitals, legal psychiatry centers, certain rehabilitation centers, home nursing care, medical centers and blood services. It notably excludes autonomous categorical hospitals, psychiatric care homes and protected housing initiatives in the federal hospital field defined in this Collective Agreement.

The transition to 100% takes effect July 1, 2021. Article 3 protects existing workers from a salary reduction when the model is introduced and provides for possible maintenance of former conditions for those who can choose. For new hiring, verify the provisions concerning new workers, then apply the amounts currently indexed.

title: IFIC: Students and Educators in the Federal Private Sector
summary: Salaried students are subject to IFIC in affected establishments. For certain educator or nurse positions, the diploma level influences the pay scale.
body: The FAQ requires assigning students under employment contracts a reference function, or a missing function with category determined by the employer. Their pay scale is determined according to the same procedures as that of other workers. For new hires after implementation, the IFIC pay scale must be explicitly stated in the written contract.

The distinction between bachelor's and non-bachelor's concerns the functions of nurse or educator in category 14 in the nursing-care department. The worker remunerated according to IFIC who provides proof of successfully completing the bachelor's is entitled to the 14 pay scale. Do not transpose this rule to every educator function.
The FAQ refers to the Collective Agreement of March 31, 2021; the date retained corresponds to the full implementation of the model, July 1, 2021. Amounts must be sought in the indexed grid in force.

title: Brussels: IFIC in Regionalized Care Sectors
summary: In Brussels, verify the COCOF/COCOM approval or subsidy and establishment type. The regime for transferred sectors differs from the federal hospital regime.
body: The page addresses CP 330 establishments approved or subsidized by COCOF or COCOM, notably care homes, psychiatric care homes, protected housing initiatives and functional re-education centers. Function assignment occurs at hiring for affected new workers.

Implementation began on January 16, 2023, or October 17, 2022 depending on the establishment's date E. Verify this date and the agreements specific to the institution before setting the salary. The date retained here is that of the general start indicated on the page.

For an educator under CP 319.02, do not automatically apply this CP 330 scheme. The IFIC presentation of Brussels non-profit sectors classifies CP 319.02 in the group without IFIC adoption planning: https://www.if-ic.org/fr/informations-generales .

title: Healthcare: Preliminary Exam and Hepatitis B Vaccination
summary: Organize medical monitoring before assignment to hazards. Vaccination obligations depend on activities and exposure, under the control of the occupational health physician.
body: The Occupational Well-being Code, version of June 13, 2026, frames the preliminary health assessment. Article I.4-26 allows its completion before the contract as the final stage of selection, under the conditions provided; it must precede the actual assignment to the position at risk.

Annex VII.1-6 provides for hepatitis B vaccination for exposed categories of medical examination or care services, including technical and maintenance staff. The exception targets administrative staff who never come into contact with substances likely to contain the virus. Institutions housing mentally ill people target nursing and educational staff.

Entrust the medical assessment to the occupational health and safety advisor-occupational physician. According to article I.4-12, a worker refusing mandatory examinations or vaccinations cannot be put to work or kept at work. Article I.4-13 prohibits selection examinations outside the legal framework.

owner.name: SPF Emploi, Travail et Concertation sociale

title: Work with Minors: Extract 596-2
summary: When the function involves education, psycho-medical-social guidance or supervision of minors, identify form 596-2. A general extract does not correspond to this purpose.
body: The Federal Public Service Justice attaches form 596-2 to article 596, paragraph 2, of the Code of Criminal Procedure. It distinguishes this form from form 595 basic and form 596-1 intended for regulated activities. Clarify the actual activities of the position in the application, especially for an educator or a role supervising minors.

The page offers a template form to choose the right extract. Separately verify the sectoral obligation for control applicable to the establishment: this page does not create a general obligation to request a record from all healthcare workers, nor a uniform validity period.

The page displays no date. The date retained is that of publication, February 2, 2017, of the Royal Decree of November 21, 2016 on the issuance of extracts. Official text verified: https://justice.belgium.be/sites/default/files/downloads/kb_21_nov_2016_modaliteiten_uittreksels_particulieren_-_gepubliceerde_versie.pdf .
